newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Lighting files to sell shares.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Lighting files to sell shares.

text.p: Advanced Lighting Technologies Inc said on Wednesday that it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer 3,000,000 shares of common stock in a public offering.

Proceeds from the offering will be used for capital expenditures, reduction of outstanding indebtedness, and general corporate purposes, including investments in joint ventures, acquisitions, and working capital, the company said.
Advanced Lighting said in a separate statement that it has closed the previously-announced $8.5 million acquisition of Parry Electrical, a division of England's W.J. Parry & Co Ltd.
